tools.name: quote
tools.title: Stock Quotes
tools.description:
Real-time stock quotes: single or batch quotes (full and short), aftermarket quotes/trades, and full-market quotes for all stocks on an exchange, ETFs, mutual funds, crypto, commodities, forex, and indexes.

Endpoints:
- aftermarket-quote (symbol*): Aftermarket Quote
- aftermarket-trade (symbol*): Aftermarket Trade
- batch-aftermarket-quote (symbols*): Batch Aftermarket Quote
- batch-aftermarket-trade (symbols*): Batch Aftermarket Trade
- batch-quote (symbols*): Stock Batch Quote
- batch-quote-short (symbols*): Stock Batch Quote Short
- full-commodities-quotes: Full Commodities Quotes
- full-cryptocurrency-quotes: Full Cryptocurrency Quotes
- full-etf-quotes: ETF Price Quotes
- full-exchange-quotes (exchange*): Exchange Stock Quotes
- full-forex-quotes: Full Forex Quote
- full-index-quotes: Full Index Quotes
- full-mutualfund-quotes: Mutual Fund Price Quotes
- quote (symbol*): Stock Quote
- quote-change (symbol*): Stock Price Change
- quote-short (symbol*): Stock Quote Short
Parameters marked * are required for that endpoint.

tools.name: news
tools.title: Financial News
tools.description:
Financial news: general market news, stock-specific news (search by symbols), crypto news, forex news, press releases, and FMP articles. Filter by date range with pagination.

Endpoints:
- crypto-news: Crypto News
- fmp-articles: FMP Articles
- forex-news: Forex News
- general-news: General News
- press-releases: Press Releases
- search-crypto-news (symbols*): Search Crypto News
- search-forex-news (symbols*): Search Forex News
- search-press-releases (symbols*): Search Press Releases
- search-stock-news (symbols*): Search Stock News
- stock-news: Stock News
Parameters marked * are required for that endpoint.

tools.name: statements
tools.title: Financial Statements
tools.description:
Financial statements and ratios: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements (standard, as-reported, TTM, growth). Key metrics, financial ratios, scores, enterprise values, owner earnings, and revenue segmentation (geographic and product). Use period="annual" or "quarter"; some endpoints also accept "FY" and "Q1"–"Q4".

Endpoints:
- as-reported-balance-statements (symbol*): As Reported Balance Statements
- as-reported-cashflow-statements (symbol*): As Reported Cashflow Statements
- as-reported-financial-statements (symbol*): As Reported Financial Statements
- as-reported-income-statements (symbol*): As Reported Income Statements
- balance-sheet-statement (symbol*): Balance Sheet Statement
- balance-sheet-statement-growth (symbol*): Balance Sheet Statement Growth
- balance-sheet-statements-ttm (symbol*): balance-sheet-statements-ttm
- cashflow-statement (symbol*): Cash Flow Statement
- cashflow-statement-growth (symbol*): Cashflow Statement Growth
- cashflow-statements-ttm (symbol*): cashflow-statements-ttm
- enterprise-values (symbol*): Enterprise Values
- financial-reports-dates (symbol*): financial-reports-dates
- financial-reports-form-10-k-json (symbol*, year*, period*): Financial Reports Form 10-K JSON
- financial-reports-form-10-k-xlsx (symbol*, year*, period*): Financial Reports Form 10-K XLSX
- financial-scores (symbol*): Financial Scores
- financial-statement-growth (symbol*): Financial Statement Growth
- income-statement (symbol*): Income Statement
- income-statement-growth (symbol*): Income Statement Growth
- income-statements-ttm (symbol*): income-statements-ttm
- key-metrics (symbol*): Key Metrics
- key-metrics-ttm (symbol*): Key Metrics TTM
- latest-financial-statements: latest-financial-statements
- metrics-ratios (symbol*): Financial Ratios
- metrics-ratios-ttm (symbol*): Financial Ratios TTM
- owner-earnings (symbol*): Owner Earnings
- revenue-geographic-segments (symbol*): Revenue Geographic Segments
